objective: Complete ReMaker v2 as a bounded surgical repair mechanism with executable Guardian capability admission, durable lease/fencing enforcement, physical RenderFabric execution, independent F07 verification, and an evidence-gated Ascalon training boundary.

security.notes: Security claims remain pending the repository's own required automation gates; no external security result is represented as executed here.

conflicts.originalConflict: ReMaker carried a documented CAP_REMAKER_REPAIR contract but the executable CapabilityRegistry did not yet expose a concrete Guardian issuance path, and the RenderFabric adapter could fall back to an implicit in-memory lease manager.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Register CAP_REMAKER_REPAIR as a production-gated capability, issue short-lived Guardian grants backed by LeaseManager fencing, wire GuardianKernel to durable disk lease persistence, and require an explicit LeaseManager in RenderFabricReMakerAdapter.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Implemented on the ReMaker branch; fresh CI admission remains required.

conflicts.originalConflict: The canonical RenderIntent contract uses an object frame range while the Python renderer previously only normalized list-shaped ranges.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Emit the canonical object form from RenderFabric and accept both canonical object and legacy two-element list forms at the Python boundary.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Implemented and covered by the dedicated ReMaker validation workflow.
